notebook_reference: https://github.com/un-fao/FERSPAS_demo/blob/main/Case1-ASIS-latest-Italy.ipynb (methodology reused; AOI is dwg7's own, not from the notebook)

derivation.aoi_identifier_scheme: slippy-map tile z-x-y (spatial ID horizontal index, no floor/altitude)
derivation.operation: rectangular window crop (no cutline, no reprojection, no resampling)
derivation.nodata_note: Source sentinel codes (251-255, including 255='water/background', see docs-internal/findings.md) are preserved unchanged; there is no 'outside the AOI' region to mask since the AOI is the crop window itself.
derivation.auth_note: Anonymous reads are denied for this bucket (fao-gismgr-asis-data); this checkout requires Google Application Default Credentials (ADC).
